sloka: क्षिपतोः शरजालानि तयोस्तौ स्यन्दनोत्तमौ ।चेरतुः संयुगमहीं सासारौ जलदौ यथा ।। ६.११०.५ ।।
transliteration: kṣipatoḥ śarajālāni tayostau syandanottamau ।ceratuḥ saṁyugamahīṁ sāsārau jaladau yathā ।। 6.110.5 ।।

translations.english: The network of arrows released by both of them from the chariots were like water streams from two clouds in the battlefield
